fusions.name: Arms of Regard
fusions.desc: Looses 6 lashes at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Ink Verdict
fusions.desc: Shoots one enemy within 6 tiles with a shot that deals 13 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Jet Away
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles. Using it increases your movement speed by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Watching Arm
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of water that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage. It also applies [Marked] for 5 seconds.
